$$

y={{field-3}}

and the straight-line solutions of the form
${c}_{1}{e}^{-t}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]$

Since ${e}^{-t}\to $ 
{{field-4}}

as $t\to \infty .$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069584/assets/a53bb4e6cd7552b92424b168d0cda90fa1085b5e72fbf8a3c37a3a948bdcf9ad.png)

The {{field-9}}  of our system looks as follows:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069584/assets/ecccffb89d43b8de4ce0952d9b8d9686e74670b4d86b29687c76355b70a6ac7d.png)
worked_solution:
The general solution of the system is

$$
[\begin{aligned}x(t) \\ y(t)\end{aligned}]={c}_{1}{e}^{-t}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}{e}^{2t}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,{c}_{1},{c}_{2}\in R.
$$

The line that passes through the origin and is parallel to ${v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]$ has the equation 

$$
y=-x
$$

and the straight-line solutions of the form
${c}_{1}{e}^{-t}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]$
lie on that line. 

Since ${e}^{-t}\to 0$ as $t\to \infty ,$ these solutions approach $\text{the origin}$ as $t\to \infty .$

Let's add the solutions to the phase space.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069584/assets/f1335e5420fe6e475cded1092e9b1ba621e0d88f46110b69ffef5e35ed080d6e.png)

The line that passes through the origin and is parallel to ${v}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2\end{aligned}]$ has the equation 

$$
y=2x
$$

and the straight-line solutions of the form
${c}_{2}{e}^{2t}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2\end{aligned}]$
lie on that line. 

Since ${e}^{2t}\to \infty $ as $t\to \infty ,$ these solutions approach $\text{infinity}$ as $t\to \infty .$

Let's add the solutions to the phase space.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069584/assets/a53bb4e6cd7552b92424b168d0cda90fa1085b5e72fbf8a3c37a3a948bdcf9ad.png)

The $\text{phase portrait}$ of our system looks as follows:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069584/assets/923e79b665f4529e579776188731896e6ce301743394e2102132f2cee7f6eaa9.png)
